usedFor: Balsio is a team messaging platform; Telegram is another chat. A “New Message” or “New Thread” in Balsio can be echoed to Telegram through “Reply To Message”, so people who live in Telegram see it.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message” in Balsio, then “Reply To Message” in Telegram
bestTemplate.why: It carries each message, optionally from one chosen thread, across to Telegram, which is more targeted than reacting to every new thread.

watchOut: “Reply To Message” answers a specific message in a Telegram chat, so it needs that chat and message ID. Balsio's triggers poll, so the reply is not instant.
